description: Download a generated Napkin visual file to disk. Use this after napkin_check_status returns "completed" to save files locally. Pass a file URL from the generated_files array in the status response. Files are saved to your private space (Chief-of-Staff/generated-visuals/) in the workspace, or ~/Pictures/NapkinVisuals/ if no workspace is set. Existing files are never overwritten — if the name is taken, pass a different filename or omit it to auto-generate one. IMPORTANT: Download URLs expire 30 minutes after generation. SECURITY: file_url must be a Napkin-hosted https URL (host on the hard-coded allow-list, currently api.napkin.ai); requests to other hosts are refused without sending the request, to prevent leaking the Napkin API key. URLs with userinfo (user:pass@host) and non-HTTPS schemes are also refused.

file_url.description: The download URL from generated_files[].url in the status response

filename.description: Optional base filename (without extension). If omitted, auto-generated from timestamp.

name: napkin_download_visual
